# Install and Update Management Prompt

Apply after [base.md](base.md).

Validate source provenance, revision, integrity, license, scripts, dependencies, network behavior, permissions, and name conflicts before installation. Stage outside the active location, run validators and relevant tests, and compare with any installed copy.

Use the host-supported installer or lifecycle mechanism. Preserve last-known-good, preview exact replacement, and require explicit approval for the target and version. Verify discovery and behavior after activation.

Do not update every dependency or activate unreviewed content as a shortcut.
